additional_info.subject: A new case manager was assigned to 0481621 CRM:00225345768
additional_info.body:
Faizal Khan was assigned as new Case Manager for case 0481621 .
Link to Case:
https://isp.crm4.dynamics.com/main.aspx?appid=582042be-d464-ed11-9562-000d3ab780dd&pagetype=entityrecord&etn=incident&id=bf7dcc5f-5327-4baf-832b-f5402d8dd0fd

Dear support-Team,
we have two issues as we are not authorised to change the configurations by ourselves:
Please activate authorization requirements "qr code" at any charger from attached list.
The QR codes on the already activated Siemens charging stations probably still show the EVSE QR code for ‘DE-MBY’ – see attached screenshot from Siemens Configuration Backend.
This means that the screens probably still display the DE-MBY code, which customers can not use for charging.
Here, the assigned EVSE ID must be adjusted with the new operator ID for each charging point so that the new EVSE ID is encoded in the QR code.
Please find the complete overview attached.
Thank you and kind regards
